tagline.en: Wan2.1 VACE — the controllable editing branch of Wan2.1 for video editing, reference-driven, and mask-guided generation.
tagline.zh: Wan2.1 VACE——Wan2.1 的可控编辑分支,支持视频编辑、参考驱动与掩码引导生成。

en: Wan2.1 VACE is the controllable-generation branch of Wan-AI's Wan2.1 video model. Rather than only generating from a prompt, it's built for editing and control: video-to-video editing, image-to-video, and generation guided by reference images or source video and masks.

It's assembled from the core Wan network with a UMT5 text conditioner, a video VAE, and the shared scheduler and runner, and comes in two sizes — a 14B checkpoint and a 1.3B diffusers variant. The 14B route defaults to a 1280×720, 81-frame, 50-step generation shape.

In WorldFoundry you can supply image references, a source video with masks, or precomputed conditioning, and it produces edited or controlled video through the shared pipeline — no separate backend required.
zh: Wan2.1 VACE 是 Wan-AI 旗下 Wan2.1 视频模型的可控生成分支。它不只是从提示词生成,更为编辑与控制而设计:视频到视频的编辑、图生视频,以及由参考图像、源视频与掩码引导的生成。
它由核心 Wan 网络搭配 UMT5 文本条件器、视频 VAE 以及统一的调度器与运行器组装而成,提供两种规模——14B checkpoint 与 1.3B 的 diffusers 变体。14B 路径的默认生成规格为 1280×720、81 帧、50 步。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你可以提供图像参考、带掩码的源视频或预先计算好的条件,它便通过统一 pipeline 产出经编辑或受控的视频——无需单独的后端。

whenToUse.en: Reach for VACE when you need control over the output — editing existing video, conditioning on reference images, or guiding generation with masks — rather than free-form text-to-video.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要对输出加以控制时——编辑已有视频、以参考图像为条件,或用掩码引导生成——而非自由式文生视频,选 VACE。

notFor.en: Overkill if you just want plain text-to-video (base Wan2.1 is simpler). The 14B checkpoint targets 720p, 81-frame generation, so plan for the compute and download.
notFor.zh: 如果只想做普通文生视频,它就显得过重(基础版 Wan2.1 更简单)。14B checkpoint 面向 720p、81 帧生成,请预留相应算力与下载。
